usedFor: ActivityInfo holds the programme records and Dropbox stores the files that go with them. A “New Record” in ActivityInfo can run “Upload File to Dropbox”, which saves a file from a public web link into a folder you choose.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A new record is when a file attached to it needs filing. “Upload File to Dropbox” saves it from its link and lets you add, replace or update when the name already exists.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public web link for the file. Both ActivityInfo triggers are polling, and “Updated Record” can run again on a record you already filed.
